rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total). Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: pool indices 12-27 (AI mental health therapy .. AI rare disease diagnosis) get dedicated, often two-angle queries today; the rest are merged into shared queries. Expansions shifted vs 2026-10-10 toward new vendors, specialties, journals and outlets. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json medicine _note: clinical/treatment only (trials, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE, hospital deployment, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery, SaMD, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior auth, patient safety/bias/liability). Disease-unspecified biology/protein-structure models belong to science - drop unless a named disease/patient/clinician is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories (swap, don't reword); vaccine/antibiotic design for treatment is fine. Fetch tips: JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (verify via Crossref); Korean feeds are KST without offset; prefer outlet RSS over site: search for recency.

recently_published_avoid.steer: Last two days skewed to imaging/radiology (prostate MRI, lung nodule, spine MRI), ambient documentation/CDS vendors (Abridge, Suki), and LLM diagnostic evaluations (AMIE, GPT-5 agents, ClinicalGPT). Today favor the emphasized specialties: cardiology/ECG, ophthalmology, dermatology, oncology treatment planning, surgical robotics, AI-designed drugs/antibodies/antibiotics/cancer vaccines entering or reading out of trials with a named disease, genomics/rare disease, telehealth/virtual nursing, liability and bias. Down-weight new radiology clearances, ambient scribe rollouts and LLM benchmark papers unless clearly bigger news.
